question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn.*` as a deprecated compatibility alias for shipped channel plugins compiled before the inbound rename, and if so what compatibility window should maintainers own?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but root and scoped policy treat PluginRuntime API compatibility as upgrade-sensitive; automation cannot decide whether this legacy runtime name should be restored or intentionally rejected.

options.title: Refresh and accept the alias contract
options.body: Resolve the current merge conflict, keep `turn` object-identical to `inbound`, and merge with deprecated-contract wording so old plugins recover while new plugins stay on `inbound`.

options.title: Reject the legacy alias
options.body: Close or decline this PR and require affected plugins to ship `channel.inbound.*` migrations, accepting that old plugin releases can keep failing on newer hosts.

recommendation.title: Refresh and accept the alias contract
recommendation.body: Resolve the current merge conflict, keep `turn` object-identical to `inbound`, and merge with deprecated-contract wording so old plugins recover while new plugins stay on `inbound`.

likelyOwner.reason: The alias removal and adjacent channel runtime handoff history both point to `steipete` as the best available owner for the compatibility-contract decision.
